title: Ascending Alarm does not work !
symptom: The selected sound file for the Ascending Alarm never starts playing; the phone only vibrates a short time. The Test button does not play the sound, and the sound file selection reverts to 'Silent'.
fix: The issue was resolved by waiting; the ascending alarm works, but the TEST ALERT button fails.
evidence_quote: You are right. The ascending alarm works well. Only the "TEST ALERT" button fails.
